shots.dramatic_purpose: Establishing Zhou Yan's quiet morning routine before the intrusion of the letter
shots.framing: Medium-wide, Zhou Yan at the sorting table, mail trays framing him
shots.camera_position: Across the sorting table, interior of the post office
shots.camera_motion: Slow push-in over the length of the shot
shots.focus: Zhou Yan sharp, foreground mail stacks soft
shots.blocking: Zhou Yan stands behind the sorting table, methodically moving letters from tray to pigeonhole
shots.subject_action: Sorting letters one by one in even rhythm
shots.environment: Interior, sea-town post office, early morning light through front windows, dust motes in sorting area
shots.lighting: Cool morning daylight from front windows, soft fill inside
shots.diegetic_audio: Paper rustling, letters dropping into pigeonholes, distant seagulls outside

boundary_risk.reason: opening shot; no prior state to carry

shots.dramatic_purpose: Discovery of the senderless letter addressed to himself, then concealment — the inciting object enters his possession
shots.framing: Tight medium on hands and face, letter readable in frame
shots.angle: Slightly over-the-shoulder into the sorting table
shots.camera_position: Behind and beside Zhou Yan, close to table height
shots.camera_motion: Static, held through the letter pull; small reframe down as the letter enters the pocket
shots.focus: Rack from Zhou Yan's hands to the letter's face, then follow to the coat pocket
shots.blocking: Zhou Yan first holds the letter up to the light, then his hand slips it into his navy work-jacket pocket
shots.subject_action: He draws one envelope from the stack, sees no sender address and his own name as recipient, hesitates, then pockets it
shots.visible_emotion: Puzzlement tightening into restrained, unreadable composure
shots.lighting: Cool window light side-lighting the envelope
shots.diegetic_audio: The envelope's paper whisper in the sudden silence; room tone

boundary_risk.reason: same scene and character, but the letter must now be in his jacket pocket and the sorting interrupted at the cut

shots.dramatic_purpose: The letter is opened in private; the photograph — the story's first image of the past — is revealed
shots.framing: Medium shot in the alley, closing to a big two-shot of hands extracting the photo
shots.angle: Eye level, alley perspective lines converging behind him
shots.camera_position: Down the back alley of the post office, several paces from Zhou Yan
shots.camera_motion: Slow dolly-in toward him as the envelope opens
shots.focus: Photo sharp as it clears the envelope; alley background falls off
shots.blocking: Zhou Yan stands against the alley wall, takes the envelope from his jacket pocket, tears it open, draws out the photograph: a girl standing beneath a lighthouse
shots.subject_action: He opens the letter, finds nothing but the old photograph, and stares at the girl under the lighthouse
shots.environment: Exterior, narrow alley behind the post office, brick walls, morning light, unattended and quiet
shots.lighting: Open morning skylight down the alley, harder shading than the interior morning
shots.diegetic_audio: Paper tearing, footsteps echo suppressed by walls, wind in the alley, far-off surf

split_hints.action_phase: letter out of the same coat pocket and opened
photograph withdrawn, girl under the lighthouse revealed

boundary_risk.reason: location and time change, but Zhou Yan must cross wearing the same navy jacket with the same letter in the same pocket

shots.dramatic_purpose: The revelation: he does not know the girl, and the handwritten line on the back names a promise he cannot remember
shots.framing: Close-up on Zhou Yan, then insertion frame of the photo's back with the handwritten line filling the lower half
shots.angle: Eye level, then flat overhead angle on the photo back for the insert
shots.camera_position: Tight in the alley, changing to directly above the photo for the insert
shots.camera_motion: Micro handheld drift on the close-up; reposition to overhead insert, static
shots.focus: His eyes first, then pinned focus on the handwriting
shots.blocking: He studies the girl's face, finds nothing familiar, then turns the photo over in his hand; insert: five handwritten characters on the blank back
shots.subject_action: He fails to recognize the girl, flips the photo, and reads the line on the back
shots.visible_emotion: Recognition failing; unease settling into stillness
shots.lighting: Overhead morning light catching the ink strokes on the photo back
shots.diegetic_audio: Wind dies; only paper and breath; the handwriting read silently on screen

split_hints.action_phase: face of the photo searched and unrecognized
insert on the back-facing photo with the handwritten line

boundary_risk.reason: an action already in progress with the photo in hand, the photograph's face already seen so its back reveal stays consistent, and his eyeline must track hand to photo
